notes: This contract pins the bounded embedded IEEE 1516.1-2025 directed-interaction slice to the official C++ declarations exported by the Requirements Lab. It covers only the non-timestamped Send Directed Interaction overload and matching no-time Receive Directed Interaction callback, plus the six object-class directed-interaction declaration overloads. The development profile routes to known target objects, excludes the sender, preserves the user tag/producer/mandatory FOM transportation, and rechecks declaration and lifecycle state at callback entry. A missing or false universally argument records a by-ownership subscription, which delivers only when the known target has at least one attribute owned by the recipient; true records a universal subscription, which delivers for every known target. Each supplied class takes the invocation's selector, while an empty class set preserves existing selectors. Timestamped/retraction behavior, directed DDM, ordering, FOM sharing-policy enforcement, MOM, remote transport, packaging, and conformance remain outside this contract.
